name: Sticky rice with squid cake
summary: Xôi chả mực is the sticky rice and the squid cake together. Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh names it beside chả mực Hạ Long and does not say how the rice is cooked. The cake line says you eat chả mực with xôi trắng.
origin: Hạ Long, on the provincial food list beside chả mực.
howToEat: The chả mực line on Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh says you eat the cake with xôi trắng. This name is that plate.
A clock was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Hạ Long, on that provincial list. Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh also names xôi chả mực among local products at phố đi bộ Bài Thơ. A stall there was not given a number.
seoTitle: Xoi cha muc — sticky rice and Ha Long squid cake
seoDescription: Xôi chả mực is the rice and the squid cake together. How the rice is cooked was not printed. Check on arrival.
